name: Big Hart Farm
description: A small pumpkin patch in 208 Norman Place, GA, Big Hart Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
